hints.title: Prefix Substring Matching
hints.text: Iterate through each word in the list and inspect whether its opening characters match pref.

hints.title: Length Check
hints.text: A word can only have pref as a prefix if word length is greater than or equal to pref length.

hints.title: Tally Matches
hints.text: Increment a counter for every word that starts with pref.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N * L) where L is prefix length
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full string equality checks fail to identify partial prefix matches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix testing executes in linear time across words with zero allocation.
